summary.text: Justin Lafferty is a Republican state representative from Tennessee House District 89 who has served since November 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Justin Lafferty assumed office representing Tennessee House District 89 on November 6, 2018.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him on the Education Administration, Insurance and Government Operations committees.
